About this page +

Our modern campus offers students all that they need to thrive. Designed to spark innovation and inspire creativity, our state-of-the-art facilities and advanced technology give students the best education possible – one that is fit for their future success.

01

Our School

BISC - South Loop is proud to offer families from around the world a personalized, international education in one of Chicago's most diverse communities.

Read more +

BISC - South Loop is proud to offer families from around the world a personalized, international education in one of Chicago's most diverse communities. We welcome families of all nationalities who wish their children to be educated in an internationally-minded and learning-focused environment.

02

school facilities

Our exceptional facilities help bring your child’s learning to life.

Read more +

Our exceptional facilities help bring your child’s learning to life. Our purpose-built learning spaces are packed with cutting-edge equipment and technology. Advanced sports and creative facilities in beautiful green surroundings, enable your child to learn and grow beyond the classroom.

  • 98,000 square feet of purpose-built space
  • Interactive technology in every classroom
  • Advanced science labs
  • Music suite with recording studio
  • Black box theatre
  • Design engineering labs

03

An environment like no other

Our bespoke studios and creative spaces have been created by world-class designers to enhance your child’s individualized learning program and inspire greater…

Read more +

Our bespoke studios and creative spaces have been created by world-class designers to enhance your child’s individualized learning program and inspire greater collaboration and teamwork between our students.

Our outdoor turf field invites students from all backgrounds to come together for sports fixtures and school activities.

With Primary and Secondary-level libraries, no student is found wanting when they’re in need of some extra research, information, or learning material.

Our state-of-the-art dance studio is light and spacious, giving students ample room for movement and self-expression.

Our 9,000-square-foot gymnasium is an awe-inspiring space bound to pump students up for a solid session of exercise or competitive sport.

Our modern industrial art workshop space includes cutting-edge wood and metal working tools and facilities.

Students can sip a well-earned barista-quality cappuccino from our onsite coffee shop.

USING TECHNOLOGY TO UNLOCK LEARNING
